name: Dear DK: Human chain against elevated corridors
description:
More flyovers won't fix Bengaluru traffic. Join the human chain against the ₹13,000 crore elevated corridors.
Demands:
1. Cancel the elevated corridor tenders.
2. Move the budget to mobility projects, with IISc guidance, within 90 days.
3. Dissolve BSMILE and set up the Bengaluru Metropolitan Land Transport Authority (BMLTA).
